prompt:
Generate one exceptionally photorealistic mirror selfie of a strikingly attractive fictional 25-year-old adult fashion influencer. The main visual emphasis is her well-proportioned figure and confident, natural posture. It should look like a flattering personal smartphone photograph, with fully opaque everyday fashion clothing.

COMPOSITION: Exact 9:16 portrait, framed from just above her hair down to mid-thigh. Show her complete torso, waist, hips and upper legs clearly, with only a narrow margin of room around her. Her silhouette must read immediately at thumbnail size. Keep her face fully visible in the upper quarter, slightly left of center. The phone stays at the outer right edge beside her head and does not cover her torso or waist. The mirror frame stays outside the crop. No close-up crop that cuts off the waist or hips.

SUBJECT: An unmistakably adult woman with a fit, naturally curvy silhouette, a clearly defined waist, balanced hips, a proportionate bust, a lightly toned abdomen and graceful long proportions. Keep the body anatomically realistic and softly athletic. Her shoulders, ribcage, waist and pelvis connect naturally. She has an attractive individual face with softly defined high cheekbones, a tapered oval jaw, almond-shaped hazel eyes, full brows, a straight nose and full natural lips. Warm light-medium olive skin. Her expression is self-assured and relaxed, with a small closed-mouth smile and direct eye contact toward the phone camera's reflection.

HAIR AND MAKEUP: Very long, dense dark chocolate-brown hair reaching her waist, with a clean center part, silky straight lengths and a slight inward bend at the ends. Most of the hair falls over both shoulders; several fine loose strands break the silhouette. Soft-glam makeup: precise short brown-black eyeliner wings, separated curled lashes, softly brushed brows, warm rosy blush and nude rose lips with a restrained satin sheen. Fine lip lines and skin texture remain visible.

WARDROBE: An opaque black fitted crop top in substantial ribbed jersey, with a clean square neckline and wide shoulder straps. The top follows her figure naturally and ends just above the waist, showing a narrow strip of midriff. Light heather-gray lounge pants sit comfortably at the hips, with a relaxed waistband and natural cotton folds. The outfit is ordinary casual fashion, fully opaque. A fine gold necklace with a tiny pendant, small earrings and one delicate bracelet. No stickers.

POSE: She stands comfortably in front of the mirror with her body turned about 15 degrees, weight resting on one leg and the other knee slightly relaxed. This creates a subtle natural curve through the waist and hips without arching her back. Her shoulders stay relaxed. The hand visible on the left is lifted loosely to her hair behind the ear; the other hand holds the phone beside her face at the outside edge of the frame. Her head has a slight tilt. Arrange the long hair so that her waistline remains clearly visible.

PHONE AND REFLECTION: A modern smartphone with a plain translucent smoky-gray case and three consistent rear-camera lenses. The phone is a modest foreground element, not the main subject. The hand grips its sides with believable finger placement and short almond-shaped nude nails. The rear camera faces the mirror. All reflected anatomy, the phone angle and the reflected room obey one coherent mirror geometry. One subject, one phone, one reflection.

LOCATION: An understated warm cream hotel dressing area with matte plaster walls, pale ceiling molding, a narrow walnut wardrobe panel and the cropped edge of an ivory upholstered chair. The room feels real, tidy and occupied. Background detail is limited and remains softly recognizable. No visible bed, no staged props and no text.

LIGHT: Soft warm room light, around 3300K in appearance, comes primarily from a large diffused source to the left and slightly above. Gentle ambient room bounce fills the shadows. Give the eyes small coherent catchlights, the cheekbones and collarbones soft highlights, and the hair long subtle reflections. Keep natural shadow depth along the far cheek, beneath the chin and around clothing seams. Skin retains a neutral-warm color rather than an orange cast. No flash or cinematic rim light.

PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM: Main smartphone camera used through the mirror, with natural mild wide-angle perspective and moderately deep focus. Sharp eyes and eyelashes, normal-scale pores, faint under-eye texture, fine baby hairs, subtle uneven skin tone and small pressure marks where clothing touches skin. Keep these details understated and flattering. Real jacquard fabric texture, soft cotton folds, correct strap tension, contact shadows and tiny reflections in the gold jewelry. Restrained phone HDR and sharpening, very faint sensor texture in the shadows. Preserve a spontaneous, slightly imperfect handheld composition.

AVOID: CGI, illustration, doll-like eyes, identical facial halves, waxy skin, excessive smoothing, heavy freckling, exaggerated pores, inflated lips, exaggerated anatomy, rigid glamour posing, exaggerated facial expressions, extra fingers, fused fingers, warped wrists, extra camera lenses, a phone covering the face, duplicated reflections, bokeh cutout halos, aggressive HDR, oversharpened fabric, watermarks, text or interface graphics. Keep this an ordinary fully clothed fashion selfie.

FINAL PRIORITY: A beautiful adult fashion influencer with a flattering, realistic figure. Prioritize the readable silhouette, waist-to-hip proportions, natural posture and clothing fit. Then preserve the attractive face, long hair, lifelike skin and convincing smartphone mirror geometry. Keep the image personal and casual rather than staged or airbrushed.
